**SIP** mein aap ek tay amount ko regular interval par—aksar har mahine—invest karte ho. **Lump sum** mein aap apni poori tay rakam ek hi baar invest karte ho.

Simple misaal: ₹12,000 invest karne hain. SIP mein ₹1,000 har mahine 12 mahine tak; lump sum mein ₹12,000 ek saath.

- **Lump sum:** Puri rakam turant market mein hoti hai. Agar market baad mein badhe, to poori rakam ko faayda mil sakta hai; agar gire, to poori rakam par girawat ka asar bhi hota hai.

Dono ka nateeja investment, samay aur market ke hisaab se badalta hai.

**Aapke liye matlab:** SIP regular bachat ke liye hota hai; lump sum ek baar mein invest karne ka tareeka hai. Kaunsa munasib hai, yeh aapki rakam, samay aur risk sehne ki kshamta par nirbhar hai.

Kul value ₹47.4 lakh thi, aur darj unrealised gain ₹3.48 lakh tha. Ho sakta hai aap kisi pichhle period ki girawat ki baat kar rahe hon—yeh snapshot uska hisaab nahi batata.

Portfolio mein stocks, funds, retirement savings, fixed income, gold, REIT aur crypto hain; isliye sabko ek hi faisle mein sametna alag-alag risks ko nazarandaaz karega. Snapshot ke mutabik beta 0.56 hai—market ke saath hilne-julne ka andaza—aur Nifty 10% girne par model portfolio ke liye lagbhag ₹2.66 lakh ki girawat dikhata hai. Yeh estimate hai, guarantee nahi.

Faisla karte waqt paisa kab chahiye, har holding ka uddeshya, risk bardasht karne ki seema aur girawat ka kaaran dekhein. Personal faisle ke liye SEBI-registered investment adviser se baat kar sakte hain.

**What this means for you:** Abhi ke snapshot mein poora portfolio loss mein nahi hai; ek din ki ya kisi recent girawat ki wajah samajhne ke liye period-wise performance dekhni hogi.

Nazar samjhata hai; faisla aapka hai. Yeh investment advice nahi hai.
